title: Faith Pleases God
story:
A little boy was learning to swim.

At first, he was afraid to move away from the side of the pool. His father stood nearby and encouraged him to trust the water and take a few strokes.

The boy looked at his father and asked, "Will you catch me if I fall?"

His father smiled and said, "I am right here. You can trust me."

The boy took a deep breath, let go of the side, and began to swim.

He was still nervous, but he moved forward because he trusted the person who was with him.

Faith often works in a similar way.

We cannot always see what God is doing or understand what lies ahead. Yet faith means choosing to trust God because we know who He is.

Hebrews 11:6 teaches us that without faith it is impossible to please God. Anyone who comes to Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who sincerely seek Him.

Faith is not pretending that we have no questions or fears.

It is choosing to trust God even when we do not have all the answers.

Sometimes God asks us to take a step before we can see the whole path.

We may need to make a difficult decision, wait for an answer, forgive someone, begin something new, or continue faithfully through a difficult season.

In those moments, faith says, "I may not understand everything, but I know God is faithful."

God wants us to seek Him sincerely, not only when we need something from Him.

When we draw near to Him through prayer, His Word, and obedience, our relationship with Him grows stronger.

The more we know God's character, the easier it becomes to trust Him.

Today, you may be facing something that requires faith.

You may not know how everything will work out, but you can take the next step with confidence because God is with you.

Seek Him with your whole heart.

Trust His promises, follow His direction, and believe that He is faithful to those who sincerely seek Him.
life_lesson: Faith means trusting God even when you cannot see the whole path. Seek Him sincerely, believe that He is faithful, and take each step knowing that He is with you.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being faithful and worthy of my trust.

Help me have faith in You even when I cannot understand what You are doing.

When I am afraid of the future, remind me that You are already there.

When I face difficult decisions, give me wisdom to seek Your will and courage to follow it.

Help me trust Your promises when circumstances seem uncertain.

Teach me to seek You sincerely, not only when I need an answer or a blessing.

Strengthen my relationship with You through prayer, Your Word, and obedience.

When doubts and questions come, help me bring them to You instead of allowing them to weaken my faith.

Give me courage to take the next step even when I cannot see the whole path.

Thank You for rewarding those who sincerely seek You and for never failing those who place their trust in You.

Help my life bring joy to Your heart through genuine faith and faithful obedience.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What situation in your life is asking you to trust God even though you cannot see the outcome?

Are you seeking God because you truly desire to know Him, or mainly because you want something from Him?

What is one step of faith you can take today?
verse: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
